number: 第二百四十八条の四の四
heading_en: Notification of Changes Relating to the SA-CVA
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、申請事項の変更や承認基準を満たさない事由の発生を遅滞なく届け出、後者の場合は改善計画等を提出する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA must promptly notify changes to the application or a failure to meet the approval standards, and in the latter case submit an improvement plan or an explanation.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall, in any of the following cases, notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details without delay. (i) Where there is a change in the matters stated in the application for approval. (ii) Where there is a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the application for approval. (iii) Where a circumstance has arisen in which the standards for approval provided in Subsection 3 are not satisfied.

Where a circumstance provided in item (iii) of the preceding paragraph has arisen, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall promptly submit either a document stating an improvement plan for that circumstance or a document stating an explanation that the circumstance is not material from the perspective of the risks of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA.

terms.en: Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA
